_note: Standalone single-mode manifest config. sk-git is a normal skill (no mode-registry.json); its references/assets/feature-catalog/playbook docs are the routed leaves that the in-SKILL.md INTENT_SIGNALS + RESOURCE_MAP router selects. scripts/ (the worktree naming allocator and hooks) and benchmark/ are not routable leaves and are excluded because they sit outside leafRoots. Consumed by generate-leaf-manifest.cjs to emit leaf-manifest.json; leaf-aliases.json is the derived identity projection of that manifest, so regenerate both together via ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs --fix.
